MoNe achieves near-perfect Sub-EM across all tasks and context lengths (0.99–1.00), substantially outperforming ICL (0.41– 0.98) and RAG (0.58–0.93).

data_generation_methods.evidence: MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone’s native window, achieving strong performance on needle-ina-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.
